note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. Objects are joined to list rows exactly as supplied; an object without an entry is only described, never judged. No custody or admissibility doctrine. Times are illustrative and imply no time limit. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations, finalState. Coordinator decision 2026-10-06 (evidence-custody-05 iteration 2): the long-labels-stress entry references are shortened to "Entry 26-0x" (still longer than the baseline references) so the cell tags can carry them.
